admission_rule: admit new bucket iff sum over live buckets of (pool_mb + per_bucket_overhead_mb) + pool_mb(new) + per_bucket_overhead_mb <= graph_budget_mb

tight.rule: sum over the 3 most probable half-A shape buckets (H,W,B,cfg) of one C1+G1 pool + 22.33 MB per-graph overhead each; i.e. only the 3 most common buckets fit

default.rule: S2 memory_budget.json graph_budget_mb (20480 - resident - largest eager workspace - 64)

wide.rule: 23552 (hard cap of an exclusive GPU0 process) - resident - largest eager workspace - 64 - 1024 (whole-process margin for the 716 MB underestimate x ~1.4); simulated only, not run on a real GPU

notes: the tight tier uses half-A frequencies (evaluation traces do not take part); the 4 tiers are monotone tight < mid < default < wide; all are recomputed if the cost table changes.
